description: This file defines API routes for user authentication, including login, registration, and retrieving the current user's profile in a FastAPI application. It handles JWT token creation, user validation, and role-based user profile initialization.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Response model for JWT token containing access token and token type.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Model representing data required for user registration.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Model representing public view of user data.

methods.name: UserPublic _public_user_from_doc(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB user document into a UserPublic model.

methods.name: Token login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends())
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and generates a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: UserPublic register_user(payload: UserCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user with hashed password and initializes role-specific profile.

methods.name: UserPublic me(user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the profile information of the current authenticated user.

ctags.name: me
ctags.pattern: /^async def me(user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user)) -> UserPublic:$/
